# Bike Mode Requirements Quality Checklist: Bicycle Option

**Purpose**: Unit-test the written requirements (spec, plan, contracts) for the bike travel mode, focused on routing behaviour / external routing dependency and mode-selector & status-message UX
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the position of "Bike" in the mode selector and its exact label specified, or only "alongside Walk and Car"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, contracts/ui.md]
- [x] CHK002 Are status texts specified for every bike outcome (computing, one route, several routes, no route, failure, with/without stops), not only by example ("e.g.")? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, contracts/ui.md] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK003 Is the bike behaviour defined when a destination is set but the user's position is not yet known ("Waiting for your location…")? [Gap, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK004 Is the bike behaviour defined when "Bike" is selected before any destination is chosen? [Gap, Spec §FR-009] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements stated for whether existing stop limits (max 5, duplicate detection) apply unchanged in bike mode? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 2] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK006 Is the content of the README update specified (which facts about bike mode: provider, alternatives, no pleasure, no detours)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK007 Are accessibility requirements for the new radio option (accessible name, keyboard selection within the radiogroup) stated or explicitly inherited from existing modes? [Gap, Non-Functional] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "routes suited to cycling" defined (e.g. as "routes returned by the bicycle profile of the routing source") rather than left open? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK009 Is "estimated cycling duration … as estimated by the routing source for bicycles" tied to a named source/endpoint in requirements or plan? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, research.md R1] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK010 Is "up to 3 cycling routes" clear about the selection rule when the source returns more or near-duplicate alternatives (same filtering as other modes)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK011 Is "error status consistent with the existing walk/car failure behaviour" pinned to concrete text for bike? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK012 Is "same format as walking and car routes" defined for distance and duration (units, rounding, "h min" form)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do the status examples in Acceptance Scenario 1.1 ("by bike", "N cycling routes · fastest …") match the wording in FR-006 and contracts/ui.md exactly? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §FR-006] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK014 Is the "no forced detours" rule consistent between FR-008, the edge case "Only one cycling route", and plan research R2? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK015 Is the pleasure exclusion stated consistently in FR-007, Assumptions, and the UI contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK016 Are the mode identifier ("bike"), display label ("Bike") and wording ("cycling", "by bike") used consistently across spec, data-model and contracts? [Consistency, data-model.md] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK017 Does the "Walk/Car unchanged" requirement conflict with any plan change to shared wording logic (status strings must remain byte-identical)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, plan.md] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Is "typical urban trips over 1 km" in SC-002 defined well enough (sample, cities, route pairs) to be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK019 Is SC-002's 95% threshold achievable/verifiable without a defined test corpus, or should it be restated as a provider-property check? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK020 Is "typically longer than driving" in the US1 independent test expressed as a requirement or explicitly marked non-normative? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK021 Can SC-004 ("behave identically to before") be verified against a defined baseline (existing tests, listed scenarios)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK022 Does every functional requirement (FR-001…FR-011) map to at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion? [Traceability] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for switching mode while bike routes are computing, including which status text remains visible? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for changing the destination while bike routes are computing? [Coverage, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK025 Is the "no cycling route" case with stops specified (e.g. a hint to remove a stop, as other modes do)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, contracts/ui.md] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for points the bicycle network cannot reach but walking can (e.g. pedestrian-only zones, motorway-only areas)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK027 Is behaviour specified for very long bike trips beyond duration format (e.g. any distance limit, as pleasure has for walking)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK028 Is a recovery path stated after a bike routing failure (re-selecting Bike, changing stops, retry)? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK029 Is the assumption that the existing provider offers a bicycle profile validated, with the endpoint recorded? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, research.md R1 — not verified live] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK030 Are usage-policy / rate-limit constraints of the bicycle routing endpoint documented? [Dependency, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK031 Are out-of-scope items (bike type, speed preference, elevation, bike lanes, bike-share, persistence) listed explicitly enough to prevent scope creep? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK032 Is "Walk stays the default mode" stated alongside the non-persistence assumption so the initial mode after reload is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
